title: How much perceived-stress signal is in the maternal ECG? An exclusion bound across deep-learning and heart-rate-variability representations in pregnancy
abstract: arXiv:2602.03886v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep learning can read physiological states from the electrocardiogram (ECG), prompting attempts to detect psychological stress. We asked how much information about perceived stress the maternal ECG carries. In 144 pregnant women, with every cross-validation split taken over participants, across 94 arms spanning 21 self-supervised, foundation-model, and heart-rate-variability architectures, the best discrimination of moderate-to-high stress (PSS-10 >= 19) was AUC 0.604 (95% CI 0.511-0.696), and AUC >= 0.70 was rejected in all eleven arms tested. Three pre-registered tests in a second cohort from the same center, recorded on different hardware, were null, at 30% power. Which of the three simultaneously recorded ECG channels was analyzed accounted for 96% of the predicted score's variance, against 4% between women; across 20 combinations of channel rule, label variant, and visit, the external correlation with perceived stress ran

translated_title: 孕期母体心电图中含有多少感知压力信号？跨深度学习与心率变异性表征的排除性界限
translated_abstract: 深度学习能够从心电图（ECG）中读取生理状态，这促使人们尝试用其检测心理压力。我们探究了母体心电图中究竟携带多少关于感知压力的信息。在144名孕妇中，每一次交叉验证划分均以参与者为单位进行，在涵盖21种自监督模型、基础模型和心率变异性架构的94个实验组中，对中高强度压力（PSS-10 ≥ 19）的最佳判别能力仅为AUC 0.604（95% CI 0.511-0.696），且在所有测试的11个实验组中，AUC ≥ 0.70均被排除。在同一中心使用不同硬件记录的第二队列中，三项预注册检验结果均为阴性，统计功效仅为30%。分析时选用三个同时记录的心电导联中的哪一个，解释了预测分数方差的96%，而孕妇个体间差异仅占4%；在导联选择规则、标签变体和访视的20种组合中，与感知压力的外部相关性……
tldr: 本研究通过在144名孕妇上系统评估94个深度学习与心率变异性模型组，发现母体心电图几乎不携带感知压力信息（最佳AUC仅0.604，且结果主要由心电导联选择而非个体间差异驱动），从而为ECG心理压力检测设定了一个排除性界限。
en_tdlr: This study establishes an exclusion bound showing that the maternal ECG carries little perceived-stress information—best AUC was only 0.604 across 94 deep-learning and HRV model arms in 144 pregnant women, with results driven mainly by ECG channel choice rather than between-women differences.
